Park Row Apartments is the conversion of a 19th century building formerly used as offices, located in the city centre. The apartments themselves have a modern finish but retain character. The train station is a 2-minute walk away and the development is also close to Leeds General Infirmary and The Law Courts, not to mention more bars and restaurants than you could possibly wish for.
